title: Load two notes in order
prompt: Write `joinNotes(first, second): Promise<string>`. Return the text from `first`, a slash, then the text from `second`. Call each once, and call `second` only after `first` has resolved. If `first` rejects, let the rejection through and never call `second`.
hints: The order of starting the loads matters, not just the order of the text.
If `await first()` rejects and you do not catch it, the function stops there.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Joins the texts in the wrong order.
Starts the second load before the first one finishes.

feedback: The order of starting the loads matters, not just the order of the text.
